title: Improvement of performance to form syngas utilizing water and CO2 over a particulate-Cu0.8Ag0.2GaS2-based photocathode by surface co-modification with ZnS and Ag
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01738B, Paper
Open Access

Tomoaki Takayama, Akihide Iwase, Akihiko Kudo
ZnS and Ag-comodified particulate-Cu0.8Ag0.2GaS2-based photocathode was active for syngas (H2 + CO) formation through photoelectrochemical H2O and CO2 reduction under simulated sunlight in an aqueous electrolyte.
